يتغاضى (form VI)
# يَتَغَاضَى (yataḡāḍā) /ja.ta.ɣaː.dˤaː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَغَاضَى (taḡāḍā)
# يُتَغَاضَى (yutaḡāḍā) /ju.ta.ɣaː.dˤaː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَغَاضَى (taḡāḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
